detail.longDescription:
Benzin is a simple and fast app for people in the Kurdistan Region. It brings daily gas station listings, their locations on the map, the distance from you to each station, and the latest fuel news together in one place.

IMPORTANT NOTICE

This app is independent. It does not represent or have any affiliation with any government body, ministry, or agency, and it does not provide any government services. The information shown in the app is collected from public announcements and reports submitted by users, and may be incomplete, inaccurate, or out of date. Please verify the information yourself before making any decision.

WHAT IT DOES

* Daily Listings - View the daily list of gas stations in your selected city. 750 indicates the commonly listed price per liter of gasoline in Iraqi dinars.

* Crowd Level - See how crowded a gas station is using five levels, from "Very Low" to "Very High", and see what other users have reported. Only users who are nearby can submit reports.

* Closed Stations - If the pumps are not operating, users can report the station as closed. A station is only marked as closed after a certain number of different users report the same status.

* Nearest Gas Stations - If you allow location access, the app shows the distance to each gas station in kilometers and sorts them from nearest to farthest.

* Map - View gas stations on an OpenStreetMap map. Gas stations in your selected city are displayed with a different color.

* News - Read the latest fuel-related news and announcements from the Kurdistan Region.

* Notifications - Receive notifications when a new list for your selected city is published. You can disable notifications in Settings.

* Select Your City - Receive only the news and gas station listings for the city you select.

* Dark and Light Mode - Choose your preferred appearance or follow your device's system settings.

FEATURES AND PRIVACY

No account is required. The app does not ask for your name, phone number, or email address. Your location is used only on your device to calculate the distance to gas stations. Your location is never sent to any server or stored anywhere. You can deny location access and continue using the app normally, but distances will not be displayed.

The app does not sell fuel or any other products and is not affiliated with any gas station.
